title: Implement Tauri WebView backend lifecycle authority findings
summary: Verified and implemented actionable Tauri/WebView/backend lifecycle authority findings from the review packet. WebView validation now fails closed in Tauri startup, active network stops report preserved work instead of false stopped authority, bootstrap bearer tokens are scrubbed from global WebView state after API client capture, eval is removed from CSP, bundle targets are Windows-only, and debug automation release fencing now has regression coverage.
reason: The operator requested end-to-end implementation of confirmed actionable code issues extracted from the Tauri/WebView/backend lifecycle authority Markdown review packet.

behavior_after: Tauri startup treats every backend-served WebView validation failure as fatal; confirmed network stop returns and commits active_work_preserved with backend active-work evidence when local jobs or remote claims remain; WebView bootstrap globals are rewritten without bearer tokens after the API client captures the token in closure state; Local API and Tauri CSP no longer allow unsafe-eval; Tauri bundle targets are msi/nsis; debug automation cfg release no-ops are covered by scaffold tests. Removing unsafe-inline remains blocked pending a separate nonce/hash or external bootstrap redesign.
